DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物をお届けいただいたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought in a found item, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、交通カードです。落とさないよう財布へ入れたら、自分のカードと二枚重なりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったカードを財布へ入れ私物と重なったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a transit card. I put it in my wallet so I would not drop it, and it ended up stacked with my own card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you put the found card in your wallet and mixed it with your belongings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらを拾ったか、見分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you distinguish which one you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私のカードには名前があります。拾った方にはなく、角に猫のシールがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前とシールで二枚を見分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine has my name. The found one has no name and a cat sticker on the corner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two cards by the name and sticker. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使ったり、残高を調べたりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you use it or check its balance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。ただ、間違えて自分の物として使わないよう分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用で取り違えを防ぎたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. But I want to separate them so I do not accidentally use it as my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is unused and you want to prevent a mix-up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二枚の特徴を確認し、拾った一枚をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check both cards' features and take the one you found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 猫のシールがある方が拾った物です。自分の名前のある方は手元に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届けるカードを指定して私物を手元へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The one with the cat sticker is the found card. I will take back the one with my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the card being handed in and take back your own. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us where and when you found it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三十分前、バス停の椅子の下です。届けるのは猫のシールの一枚だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見場所と時刻を述べ一枚だけ届けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thirty minutes ago, under a bus stop seat. I am handing in just the one with the cat sticker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the discovery location and time and confirm you are handing in only one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身のカードはお返しし、拾得した一枚を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will return your card and record the one found card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居届は、もう提出されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you already submitted a postal change-of-address notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。明日、旧居の郵便受けの鍵を管理会社へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居届未提出で旧居の鍵を返す予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. Tomorrow I return the key to the old home's mailbox to the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you have not submitted the notice and plan to return the old key. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しいお住まいへは、すでに移られたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already moved to your new home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一週間前です。鍵を持っている間は自分で取りに行けると思い、届を後回しにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居済みだが郵便を取れるので後回しにしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, a week ago. I thought I could collect mail myself while I had the key, so I put off the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you already moved but delayed the notice because you could collect mail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届の受付と転送の開始は確認が必要です。今からの申込みをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check acceptance of the notice and the start of forwarding. We will guide you through applying now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵を返した翌日から必ず転送されると考えてはいけないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵返却日が自動的な転送開始日ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I must not assume forwarding definitely starts the day after I return the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the key-return date does not automatically determine forwarding start. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始については手続きの案内を確認してください。旧居への立入りも管理会社へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the procedure's guidance for the start date. Also consult management about entering the old home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返した後は勝手に入らず、残った郵便物の扱いを管理会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却後の立入りをせず管理会社に郵便の扱いを聞くと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: After returning it I will not enter without permission. I will ask management how remaining mail is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not enter after returning the key and will ask management about mail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人にも新住所を連絡しておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would also be good to tell senders your new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日届けを出し、開始を確認します。鍵の返却と郵便の受取を別々に調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届の開始と鍵返却を分けて調整すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit the notice today and check when it starts. I will coordinate key return and mail receipt separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separately coordinate forwarding start and key return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。新旧住所と転居日を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check old and new addresses and moving date and guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録変更の控えをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check your copy of the registration change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所は合っていますが、口座番号が全部見えません。別の口座の控えでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号が一部見えず別口座か心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address is correct, but I cannot see the full account number. Is this a copy for a different account?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you worry it is another account because part of the number is hidden. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えない部分があることだけでは、別口座とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A hidden part alone does not establish it is a different account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後の三桁は私の口座と同じです。省略した表示かもしれないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 末尾が一致していることを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The final three digits match my account. It might be an abbreviated display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the final digits match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象となった口座と変更内容を、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check the affected account and changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を全部書き足せば分かりやすいと思いましたが、控えには手を加えず見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えを書き足さず原状で確認してもらうと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought adding the full number would make it clearer, but I will show the copy without altering it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not add to the copy and will have it checked as it is. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認用にお持ちの通帳などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a passbook or similar for verification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この通帳です。口座全体の番号は人前で読み上げず、資料で照合していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳を提示し番号を読み上げず照合するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This passbook. I do not want to read the full account number aloud in public; please compare the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the passbook and request comparison without reading the number aloud. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料を使って対象を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will use the documents to verify the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ口座の住所変更と確認できてから保管します。省略表示だけで変更漏れとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象確認後に保管し省略だけで漏れと判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep it after confirming it is the address change for the same account. I will not infer a missed change just from abbreviation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it after verification and not infer an omission from abbreviation alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。対象と変更した項目を確認して結果をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will check the account and changed fields and explain the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of product are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の原料を使うものです。国内製造とあれば、それで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内製造で原料も国内産と判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One made with domestic ingredients. Does “manufactured domestically” mean it meets that condition?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether domestic manufacture establishes domestic ingredient origin. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の表示では、作った場所と原料の産地が別に書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product separately lists the manufacturing location and the ingredients' origins.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原料の欄には外国の名前があります。国内で作ったことと、原料が国内のものということは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 製造場所と原料欄の外国名を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The ingredients field names a foreign country. Making it domestically is separate from the ingredients being domestic.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish manufacturing location from the foreign country in the ingredient field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご希望の条件に関わる欄を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Check the field relevant to the condition you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一語だけで買わず、原料の表示も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 製造の一語だけで買わず原料表示を確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to buy based on that one phrase alone. I want to check ingredient labeling too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check ingredients rather than buy on the manufacturing phrase alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の商品も、包装ごとに確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check other products package by package too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは原料の産地が見えにくいです。担当に確認できる資料があるか聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品の読みにくい産地について資料確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The ingredients' origin on this one is hard to see. Could you ask the responsible staff whether there is documentation to confirm it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request document checking for another product's hard-to-read origin. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。はっきりしない部分を推測してはご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check. We will not give guidance based on guessing unclear details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。原料の情報が確認できてから、希望に合う商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認できた原料情報で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After confirming ingredient information, I will choose a product meeting my wishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose using confirmed ingredient information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の資料があるか担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask the responsible staff whether labeling documents exist.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図を見ながらお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここが現在地とありますが、写真の入口が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の現在地と実際の景色が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This says current location, but I cannot see the entrance shown in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the photo's current location differs from the actual view. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その地図は、どこで撮ったものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you take the map photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南門です。その後、池を半周してここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図を撮った場所と移動経路を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the south gate. Then I walked halfway around the pond to get here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the photo location and your route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の現在地の印は、その案内図を置いた南門の位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The photo's current-location marker is the south gate where that map is installed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩くと印も今の場所になると思っていました。ここはどこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印は更新されないと気づき今の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the mark would become my current position as I walked. Where are we now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Realize the mark does not update and ask your current location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池の北側の広場です。こちらの案内図なら、この広場が現在地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The square north of the pond. On this map, this square is the current location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい図では池が南側ですね。南門の写真と向きを比べて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の案内図と池の位置を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the new map the pond is south, right? I will compare orientation with the south-gate photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the current map with the pond's position. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置が違うことを確かめて、行きたい場所までの園路をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check that the locations differ, then look at the paths to your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地をこの広場に直して考えます。前の印から道をたどり直すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の広場を出発点にして経路を考えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will treat this square as the current location. I will stop retracing routes from the old marker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will plan the route starting at the current square. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。今いる北側の広場を出発点にしてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Start from the northern square where you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような経路をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of route are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腰がつらいので、乗り換えが一番少ない経路にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腰の負担を減らすため乗り換えを少なくしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My lower back hurts, so I want the route with the fewest transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want fewer transfers to reduce lower-back strain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗り換えを減らしたいのですね。立っている時間も気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want fewer transfers. Are you also concerned about standing time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。長く立つのが難しくて、座れるかが気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立ち続けることが難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Standing for long is difficult, and I am concerned whether I can sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is hard to keep standing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗り換えが少ないだけでは、座れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Fewer transfers alone do not guarantee a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、次の列車とその後の列車では、待つ場所や乗り方を比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車ごとの待ち方を比較できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then can I compare the waiting locations and boarding methods for the next train and the one after?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can compare how to wait for each train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時刻とホームは案内できますが、空席の保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can give times and platforms, but cannot guarantee empty seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座れると決めつけず、少し余裕を取って移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席を前提にせず時間の余裕を持ちたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to allow extra time to move without assuming I can sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want extra time without assuming an empty seat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で休める場所も確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also check places where you can rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗り換えの数だけで選ばず、待つ時間と休める場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗り換え数以外に待ち時間と休憩場所も聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Rather than choosing just by transfers, please tell me waiting time and resting places too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about waiting time and rest locations besides transfer count. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの経路から順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain starting with this route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble writing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。契約書は「サンハイツ」、案内は「SUN HEIGHTS」です。別の建物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの書類で建物名が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The contract says “San Heights,” but the instructions say “SUN HEIGHTS.” Are they different buildings?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain two documents have different building names. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この二枚だけで別の建物とは判断できません。所在地と部屋番号は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: These two papers alone do not establish different buildings. Do the street address and room number match?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地も部屋番号も同じです。建物名だけが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号は一致すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street address and room number are the same. Only the building name differs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say street address and room number match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを、書類を出す際にもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please mention that difference when submitting the documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本語に自分で訳して書けばいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で訳した名前を書こうとしていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I could translate it into Japanese myself and write it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you were planning to write your own translation of the name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自己判断で新しい表記を作らず、こちらで確認してから記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not create a new spelling yourself. Let's check here first, then fill it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書と案内の両方を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方の書類を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you look at both the contract and instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check both documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。どちらの表記を使うか、住所の情報と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check which spelling to use along with the address information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認が終わってから、案内された建物名の表記で記入します。部屋番号は三〇二です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号を示し確認後の表記で記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking is finished, I will write the building name as instructed. The room number is 302.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the room number and say you will use the verified spelling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番地と部屋番号の一致を確認しました。建物名に使う表記を確かめてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed street address and room number match. We will verify the building-name spelling before advising you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change your appointment date, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。母の介護でその日に来られません。母の病名も説明する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 介護で来られない理由と説明範囲の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I cannot come that day because I care for my mother. Do I need to explain her diagnosis too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain caregiving prevents attendance and ask how much to explain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約変更のご相談では、まず来られない日と希望日を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: For changing appointments, first we ask the unavailable date and desired date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の詳しい病状までは、ここで話さなくてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の詳しい病状が必要か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I do not have to describe my family's detailed medical condition here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether detailed family medical information is required. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の受付に必要な内容を確認します。ご自身の診療に関わることは担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check what is needed to accept the change. Ask the responsible staff about matters affecting your own care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の受診について、薬が次の候補日まで足りるかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自身の薬が候補日まで足りるか気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: For my own visit, I also worry whether my medicine will last until the next possible date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you worry whether your own medicine lasts until the proposed date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それは受付だけで判断できませんので、担当に確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Reception alone cannot decide that, so we need to check with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付だけ変える前に、薬について相談することも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更前に薬の相談も担当へ伝えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before changing just the date, please also tell them I want to discuss my medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to pass on your medication question before changing the appointment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の予約日と、お薬についてのご相談を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check the current appointment date and your medication question.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約は来週の月曜です。薬の件を確認してから変更日を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の予約日を示して確認後に変更日を決めたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My appointment is next Monday. I want to decide the new date after checking about the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the original date and say you want the new date decided after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 来週月曜の予約と、お薬が足りるかのご相談として担当へ伝えます。変更日は確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will tell the responsible staff about next Monday's appointment and whether your medicine will last. We will advise a changed date after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の登録番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know the bicycle's registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この写真の四桁です。鍵の横に貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の数字を登録番号として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, these four digits in the photo. I stuck them beside the lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the photo's numbers as the registration number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は、どのような番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of number is that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号式の錠を使うために、私が書いたメモです。登録番号とは違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字が私用の錠の番号だったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A note I wrote for using the combination lock. It was not the registration number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that the digits were your private lock code. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 錠の番号を登録番号として記録しないよう、資料を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check documents so the lock code is not recorded as the registration number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 購入時の控えがあります。この登録の欄を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入控えの登録欄の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the purchase record. Could you check this registration field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the registration field on your purchase copy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらの番号と、車体の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will check this number and bicycle details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵を開ける数字は、相談に必要な登録情報とは分けて扱いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 解錠の数字と届出用情報を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want the unlocking digits handled separately from the registration information needed for this consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want the unlock code separated from reporting information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。公開する写真などにも、その数字が写っていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Also check that those digits are not visible in photos you make public.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 特徴を示す時はそのメモを見せず、登録控えを使って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴写真に私用番号を出さず登録控えで説明すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: When showing features, I will not show that note. I will explain using the registration copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the private code out of feature photos and use registration records. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。登録情報と、なくなった場所や時刻を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask registration details, missing location and time in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日の郵便物についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about yesterday's mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。必要な添付書類を一枚入れ忘れました。今、その封筒に足せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送済みの封筒に不足書類を足せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I forgot one required attachment. Can I add it to that envelope now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add a missing document to an already-sent envelope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すでに差し出されたものへ、この場で中身を足せるとはご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot tell you that contents can be added here to something already posted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ相手に着いていないので、ここで開けられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未到着なら開けられると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has not reached the recipient yet, so I thought it could be opened here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you thought it could be opened before arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、控えと発送状況を確認しましょう。提出先へも不足の扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First let's check your receipt and shipping status. Also ask the recipient how missing documents are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不足分だけ別に送れば受理されるか、提出先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足分だけの追送可否を提出先へ確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask the recipient whether sending only the missing item separately will be accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check whether a missing-only follow-up mailing is accepted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認と、郵便物の取扱いについての相談は分けて進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please handle that confirmation separately from consultation on postal handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの控えを見てください。出したのは昨日の夕方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えと差出時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please look at this receipt. I sent it yesterday evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and posting time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取扱いを確認します。追加の書類はまだ差し出しませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will check handling. Are you holding off posting the extra document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。相手の回答を聞いてから、追送するのかほかの方法か決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手の回答前に追加発送せず方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After hearing the recipient's response, I will decide whether to send it separately or use another method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not send more before the recipient answers and will decide on a method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず、この一件の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we will check this mailing's status.
